wo-jpfa-JR1068.d:
Job Descriptions :

1. Monitor the availability and inventory of raw materials, auxiliary materials, and premixes using FIFO/FEFO principles.
2. Coordinate warehouse operations, including unloading, loading, storage, and material verification.
3. Ensure proper material classification, inventory accuracy, and report shrinkage or aged packaging/labels.
4. Prepare daily warehouse reports while maintaining compliance with OHS and 5S standards.
5. Supervise warehouse staff and drive continuous improvement through performance monitoring and process innovation.

Qualifications :

1. Minimum Vocational (D3/D4) or Bachelor's degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering / Statistics / Management / Accounting

2. Have experience as Raw Material Coordinator minimum 3 years / Procurement Staff minimum 3 years

3. Ability in English (verbal & written)

4. Willing to work in dynamic factory environment and in East Java

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

1. Memantau ketersediaan dan persediaan bahan baku, bahan pembantu, dan premix dengan menerapkan prinsip FIFO/FEFO.
2. Mengoordinasikan operasional gudang, termasuk proses bongkar muat, penyimpanan, dan verifikasi material.
3. Memastikan klasifikasi material yang tepat, keakuratan stok, serta melaporkan penyusutan dan kemasan/label yang telah berumur.
4. Menyusun laporan harian gudang serta memastikan penerapan standar K3 dan 5S.
5. Mengawasi kinerja staf gudang dan mendorong perbaikan berkelanjutan melalui pemantauan kinerja dan inovasi proses.

Kualifikasi:

1. Minimal Diploma (D3/D4) atau Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknik Industri, Statistika, Manajemen, atau Akuntansi.
2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Koordinator Bahan Baku atau Staf Procurement.
3. Mampu berbahasa Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan.
4. Bersedia bekerja di lingkungan pabrik yang dinamis dan di area Jawa Timur

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. Support day-to-day animal health activities to ensure effective disease prevention, biosecurity, and animal welfare across operations. The role focuses on field support, monitoring, and documentation under established animal health protocols.
Support implementation of animal health programmes, including vaccination, biosecurity, and routine health checks.
Assist in monitoring animal health indicators, morbidity, and mortality trends.
Support field execution of health protocols in coordination with operations and veterinary teams.
Assist in investigation and reporting of animal health issues and incidents.
Ensure adherence to animal health regulations, welfare standards, and biosecurity procedures.
Maintain health records, logs, and routine reports.
Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance animal welfare and farm performance.
Follow established animal health procedures, safety practices, and governance requirements.
